stem.text: A projectile is launched at an angle to the horizontal at time $t = 0$. It travels over horizontal ground, as shown.

stem.alt: Arc-shaped path of a projectile above a grey horizontal ground surface, with an arrow on the path and labels path of projectile and ground.

stem.text: Which graph best shows the variation with $t$ of the speed of the projectile from when it is launched to when it lands on the ground?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled speed and horizontal axis labelled t, showing a horizontal line.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled speed and horizontal axis labelled t, showing a line that falls and then rises.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled speed and horizontal axis labelled t, showing a curve that falls and then rises.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled speed and horizontal axis labelled t, showing a curve that falls to a minimum and then rises.
